observations.why: Present-tense 'we are adopting' carries energized commitment to a new tool, registering enthusiasm rather than neutral report.
Quantified superlative comparison delivered as a performance claim carries energized positive valence about the new system's capability.
Commissive timeline stated in settled, forward-looking register — committed but not energized, conveying calm confidence.
Summary framing of settled outcomes in a neutral, organized register conveys satisfied contentment without arousal elevation.
